# The sidebar's file tree changes files (Kero's Files), each undoable:
# New File/Folder (a slash makes the folders on the way), Rename in place
# (Esc leaves it), Duplicate, Move to Trash (⌘⌫; a probe's Trash is its
# own folder), and files dropped in from "the Finder" (@FINDER@): copied,
# numbered past a name taken, moved with ⌘. tests/run.sh makes @DIR@
# with a.txt and src/, and @FINDER@ with pic.png.
# (Made again here, so a second attempt — CI retries a failed probe — starts as the first did.)
shell:rm -rf @DIR@ @FINDER@ && mkdir -p @DIR@/src @FINDER@ && echo one > @DIR@/a.txt && echo png > @FINDER@/pic.png
type:cd @DIR@
key:enter
wait:1.0
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree:src/
# New File… beside a.txt: docs/ made on the way (and the file opens to be written).
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:New File…
sheet-type:docs/notes.md
sheet:Create
expect-tree:docs/notes.md
expect-shell:ls @DIR@/docs ==> notes.md
# A name taken already says so.
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:New Folder…
sheet-type:src
sheet:Create
expect-sheet-text:is there already
sheet:OK
# Renamed in place: the stem is selected, so typing replaces it.
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Rename
type:b
key:enter
expect-tree:b.txt
expect-tree-not:a.txt
undo:go
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree-not:b.txt
# Esc leaves the name as it was.
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Rename
type:zzz
key:escape
expect-tree:a.txt
expect-tree-not:zzz.txt
# Return on a selected file renames it too (Finder's key).
tree-select:a.txt
key:enter
type:c
key:enter
expect-tree:c.txt
expect-undo:Rename
undo:go
expect-tree:a.txt
# Duplicate, then ⌘⌫ (and back).
tree-select:a.txt
tree-menu:Duplicate
expect-tree:a copy.txt
expect-undo:Duplicate
tree-select:a copy.txt
key:cmd+backspace
expect-tree-not:a copy.txt
expect-shell:ls @DIR@ ==> a.txt
expect-undo:Move to Trash
undo:go
expect-tree:a copy.txt
# From the Finder: copied into src/, then again as "pic 2.png"; ⌘ moves.
tree-drop:@FINDER@/pic.png>src
expect-tree:src/pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ ==> pic.png
tree-drop:@FINDER@/pic.png>src
expect-tree:src/pic 2.png
tree-drop-move:@FINDER@/pic.png>.
expect-tree:pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ | wc -l | tr -d ' ' ==> 0
undo:go
expect-tree-not:pic.png
expect-shell:ls @FINDER@ ==> pic.png
